decisions.rationale: Positive self-reported progress (email:d35c3f8a) and first project reached day 3, so engagement is real. But no invite sent, no milestone by day 6, and the welcome call was a no-show (calendar:ba5dfc32), suggesting low urgency. 8 days left gives moderate odds.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Silver Group's setup
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Glad to hear the first project is starting to click — that's usually the point where things speed up. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the next step most teams find useful is bringing someone else in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? Happy to walk through that first invite with you and answer anything else as you dig in.

Best,
Chidi
